JUDGMENT
NON-REPORTABLE
IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
CIVIL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
CIVIL APPEAL NO. 1651 OF 2015
[@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (C) NO. 27080 of 2013]
M/S ANVIL CABLES PVT LTD                    Appellant(s)
                                VERSUS
COMMNR.OF CENTRAL TAXES & SERVICE TAX      Respondent(s)
J U D G M E N T 
PER ANIL R. DAVE, J.
Leave granted.  
Looking at the peculiar facts of the case, in 
the interests of justice, we direct that upon payment 
of  Rs.  25,000/-  by  way  of  costs  to  the  sole 
respondent within two months from today, the impugned 
Judgment shall be set aside and Tax Appeal No. 3 of 
2013  shall  be  restored  to  its  original  number  and 
shall be heard on merits by the High Court.  
With the above directions, the Civil Appeal is 
allowed with the abovesaid costs.  
It  is  clarified  that  if  the  amount  is  not 
deposited  within  the  stipulated  time,  this  order 
shall  not  operate  and  the  impugned  Judgment  shall 
remain in force.  
.......................J.
   
           [ANIL R. DAVE ] 
.......................J.
   
           [SHIVA KIRTI SINGH] 
New Delhi;
February 06, 2015.
